$comment: THE declaration of every configuration value the Delivery Service reads (#760).
A config value has to traverse five links to affect the running DS, and each is a
separate hand-maintained list: Doppler -> KEYS in .github/scripts/sync-ds-secrets.sh
-> the wrangler config -> worker/index.ts -> the DS reading the OS env var. Three of
the five were silently missing for POLLIS_DS_METRICS_TOKEN, and it took three PRs to
notice, because each broken link hid the next.
Link 4 is the trap: a wrangler `var` binds to the WORKER, not to the container, and a
Secrets Store binding reaches the container only if worker/index.ts forwards it. So
config can be correct in Doppler, in the Secrets Store and in wrangler.jsonc, deploy
green, and still never reach the DS.
scripts/check-ds-config-chain.py verifies this file against every link, in BOTH
directions: a declared key missing from a link fails, and an env var the DS reads that
is not declared here fails. Adding config without wiring it end to end is therefore a
CI failure rather than a silent no-op discovered months later.

secrets.$comment: Secrets Store -> container. Must appear in the sync script's KEYS, in each listed environment's `secrets_store_secrets`, and in SECRET_KEYS in worker/index.ts.

container_vars.$comment: Non-secret config that must reach the CONTAINER. Must appear in both wrangler configs' `vars` AND be forwarded through `envVars` in worker/index.ts. Forgetting the forward is the #720 bug.

$comment: Non-secret tunables an environment MAY set as a wrangler `var`; unset means the DS's
compiled-in default. Must be read by the DS and listed in TUNABLE_VAR_KEYS in
worker/index.ts (forwarded only when set). Neither wrangler config is required to set
them. Today only dev sets the two OTP tiers (the mobile e2e suites sign up many
accounts from one IP) and POLLIS_DS_OPS_LOG (the dev-only request-otp ops log,
src/ops_log.rs; tests/otp_ops_log.rs fails if prod ever sets it). Prod keeps the defaults.

worker_vars.$comment: Read by the WORKER itself and deliberately NOT forwarded to the container. Declared so the checker does not demand a forward that would be meaningless.

aliases.$comment: Alternate names the DS accepts, each falling back to a delivered key (broker.rs). Never delivered under this name; nothing to wire.

$comment: Read by the DS with a compiled-in default and NOT settable in any environment — there
is no wrangler var and no forward, so setting one would require a code change.
Listed explicitly rather than fixed because the default IS the policy in each case, and
silently adding operator knobs is how #720 happened in reverse. If one of these ever
needs to be tunable, promote it to container_vars and wire all the links — the checker
will refuse a half-done job.
